follow-up time: Duration of first stage of labor
outcome: Duration of latent phase of labor
Duration of active phase of labor
cohort: 349 women with a term, singleton, breech fetus who experienced spontaneous labor onset between 2010 and 2018.
finding: The first stage of labor progression in women with breech presentation can be divided into a latent and active phase, similar to cephalic presentation, and parity significantly influences labor progression.
